mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, we are seeing 52 degrees with clear skies by the Verona Area High School, an elevated air quality index of 61, and a beautiful Full Moon.

The city is moving forward with important business, as the Plan Commission will meet on Wednesday, November 4th, at 6:30 p.m. to review several site plans and plats, including the Ardent Glen third addition. Additionally, property tax bills will be mailed by December 15th, with payment options including online, mail, or drop boxes.

There is plenty to do in our area, starting with the Dane County Farmer's Market today, along with live music performances throughout the day at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can join yoga sessions on Sunday, October 26th, or test your knowledge at trivia nights starting Monday, October 27th.

Regarding local public safety, the Verona Police Department reported that on Thursday, October 15th, they arrested a school bus driver for O W I after receiving reports of dangerous driving behavior while students were on board.
Stop by for a scoop of our flavor of the day, which is Turtle. Our local Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 10:30 PM tonight.
